title: Define Data Model for Tracked Items and Snapshots
description: Define the data structures for tracked financial items and timestamped snapshots, including fields for actual and estimated values.
acceptanceCriteria: Data model supports all required fields
Supports multiple snapshot entries with timestamps

title: Build Snapshot Entry Flow
description: Implement the UI and backend flow for users to enter timestamped snapshots with editable values.
acceptanceCriteria: UI shows editable list of tracked items
Can create and save new snapshots
Estimated values toggle works per item

title: Build Dashboard and History View
description: Build dashboard UI to show total net wealth, change vs prior snapshot, category breakdown, and trends.
